10/G.goal: Explain cybersickness/VIMS, the symptoms that indicate its onset, why reducing it matters, and the internal and hardware factors that can cause or increase it.
10/G.achieves: Equips the learner with foundational knowledge of a key psycho-physiological and technological issue in XR, enabling them to assess and address cybersickness when understanding or implementing an XR system.

10/O1.goal: Explain what cybersickness/VIMS is, including the symptoms that indicate its onset and why reducing it matters for VR usability.
10/O1.achieves: Gives the learner the foundational terminology and rationale for treating cybersickness as a human-factor barrier to VR acceptance and usable XR design.

10/O2.goal: Describe how internal user-related factors and external hardware factors can cause or increase cybersickness.
10/O2.achieves: Lets the learner identify cybersickness risk factors from both user and device perspectives, supporting the course aim of addressing XR issues from user and developer viewpoints.
